svg.text: A closed loop, not a one-time turn
A new detection updates the target; the IMU keeps correcting between frames.
The rear camera is offset −6.75 in from the robot center.
Field placement illustrates the triangle; the 39 px measurement comes from the supplied sensor image.
Vision lost? Follow remembered IMU heading for up to 2.5 s.
Mode 2 rotates only. Backward pickup uses a separate function.
